title: Malformed SSE retry hints preserve event delivery
summary: The merge delivered both events after an invalid retry hint. It still accepted a trailing space as part of a 25 ms retry.

change.description: The event-stream reader checks for ASCII digits and treats unrepresentable millisecond values as unusable hints.

notes: The public observation records each ServerSentEvent envelope, the terminal signal, and both exception types when the stream fails.
